repair.what: Evidence-record repair of four accuracy findings on this bundle: (1) missing disabled-state and keyboard :focus-visible representatives and the chip-count probe; (2) a false "0 missing shots" inventory; (3) an overstated "byte-identical unselected states" claim plus pointer-hover bleed in off-state shots; (4) a mis-stated .cmg-roleseg live-path / publish-route error note. Repaired only in bundle-local tooling, captures, sheets, provenance and RESULTS.md.
repair.pointerPolicy: Before every non-hover read and shot the pointer is parked at a viewport corner outside the target AND outside the target's control group after scrollIntoViewIfNeeded, settled 150ms, and verified unhovered (el.matches(":hover") === false); re-verified immediately before the shot. Parking outside the group matters because an adjacent selected option left hovered causes a 1px bleed at the clipped edge even when the target itself is not hovered. Deliberate hover probes hover, then re-park.
repair.note: No product code, test, fixture, lockfile or doc in the repository changed; the candidate worktree stayed clean at fbdcd0d for the whole repair. The four repaired findings were evidence-record-only and independent reviewers had already confirmed no product defect. This is NOT a clean 0/0/0 claim and NO independent review was performed after the repair.
